task.title: 缓存模式
task.shortdesc: 该小结主要介绍缓存模式的使用步骤。

p.codeblock:
创建实例和参数配置： AT+MHTTPCREATE="http://120.27.12.119:10080" +MHTTPCREATE: 0 OK AT+MHTTPCFG="cached",0,1 //设置缓存模式 OK AT+MHTTPCFG="cached",0 +MHTTPCFG: "cached",0,1,4096 OK
GET请求： AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,1,1,"/get" OK +MHTTPURC: "recv",0,200,225,145 //请求完成
读取缓存数据： AT+MHTTPREAD=0,0,225 //读取报头 +MHTTPREAD: 0,0,225,0,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2021 06:58:31 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 145 Connection: keep-alive Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true OK AT+MHTTPREAD=0,1,145 //读取content +MHTTPREAD: 0,1,145,0,{"args":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"0","Host":"localhost:6000"},"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/get"} OK
